purpose: Development of spatial fine-grid completion with dense auxiliary supervision
new_training: Two complete first passes of 23 TRAIN families, one world per family and pass; no outcome selection
sampling: Current 360-second physical acquisition worlds receive 50% of updates; the original 335 cases receive the other 50%
augmentation: Matched rotations, reflections and integer translations of inputs and both label grids; no sensor-noise changes
selection: Development VALID minimum area IoU then macro IoU; fresh physical rollout required before acceptance
inference: Auxiliary labels and auxiliary output are absent from deployed inference; only observations reach the model
